native_decision.hypothesis: MawConfig.load can enforce a fixed byte-ingestion budget before UTF-8 decoding or YAML parsing, limiting memory intake while preserving ordinary in-budget UTF-8 configuration behavior.
native_decision.reason: The receiving implementation calls Path.read_text before parsing, so the complete file is decoded into text without an intake bound. The donor supplies a concrete transferable mechanism: consume bytes only up to a declared boundary, detect the first excess byte, and refuse immediately rather than buffering the remainder. This is an additive design improvement, not a demonstrated runtime defect. Its receiving benefit is bounded pre-parser allocation and deterministic refusal of oversized maw-owned configuration files.
native_decision.adaptation: Define a receiving-owned maximum configuration size in bytes. Open the configuration as binary and read incrementally until either EOF or one byte beyond that maximum is observed. Accept only after EOF has established that the complete byte sequence is within budget; if any excess byte is observed, close and raise a source-content-free UsageError before UTF-8 decoding and before invoking YAML. Decode an accepted complete sequence strictly as UTF-8, then retain the existing unique-key loader, private YAML diagnostics, empty/comment-only handling, mapping requirement, and from_data validation path unchanged.
native_decision.maintenance: Keep the byte ceiling as one named receiving policy constant with documentation that the unit is encoded bytes, not characters. Keep the bounded reader local to configuration loading, dependency-free, and ensure the oversized-file diagnostic reports policy and path without file contents. Boundary and UTF-8 regression cases should make later policy changes explicit.
native_decision.acceptance: Original receiving tests establish that: (1) a valid UTF-8 maw configuration whose encoded form is exactly the byte ceiling loads identically to the current path; (2) a valid configuration exceeding the ceiling by one byte is refused with the designated content-free UsageError and a recording YAML loader confirms parsing was not called; (3) a multibyte UTF-8 configuration within the ceiling retains its decoded values, proving the budget counts bytes without changing normal decoding; (4) empty and comment-only in-budget files retain their existing result; and (5) a controlled short-reading binary source is read repeatedly until EOF, while a source that eventually supplies an excess byte is refused, demonstrating that acceptance means a complete EOF-terminated snapshot rather than one short read.

native_decision.adaptation: Extend the receiving line-oriented masker with an explicit type-7 state and a receiving-owned, specification-bounded start recognizer. In the Markdown-destination view, replace type-7 block characters with position-preserving spaces; in the HTML-navigation view, retain actual type-7 markup just as actual type-6 navigation markup is retained, while continuing to mask code and other literal regions.
native_decision.maintenance: Keep recognition and termination in the existing single-pass block masker, reuse its line splitting and position-preserving replacement, and use bounded anchored matching with no new dependency. Document type-7 paragraph and blank-line rules beside the state. Maintain paired Markdown-view and HTML-navigation-view cases so future masking changes cannot silently conflate the channels or alter offsets and line endings.

Once started, the donor continuation parser ends type-7 blocks on a blank line, using the same blank-line termination condition as type 6.

decision.hypothesis: The receiving scanner can add bounded top-level GFM type-7 raw-HTML masking without changing inline Markdown, source offsets, or the separate HTML-navigation view.
decision.reason: The scoped receiving implementation tracks and masks HTML block types 1–6 but has no type-7 state or start branch. The donor supplies a relevant mechanism: recognize type 7 only in an eligible block context, forbid paragraph interruption including lazy continuation, and terminate the block at a blank line. Adapting those boundaries would prevent documentation-link scanning from treating Markdown-looking content inside eligible type-7 blocks as links while preserving real navigation markup and ordinary inline constructs.
decision.adaptation: Extend the receiving line-state masker with an explicit type-7 start predicate constrained to top-level, non-indented HTML-block context. Start it only when no paragraph is being continued, mask through the first blank-line boundary while preserving every character position and line ending, and apply it only to the Markdown-destination view. Keep the HTML-navigation view capable of observing genuine tags and anchors rather than restoring or suppressing type-7 regions indiscriminately.
decision.maintenance: Keep the type-7 predicate and state adjacent to the existing raw-HTML block handling, document its paragraph and blank-line boundaries, reuse the existing single-pass line budget and position-preserving masking contract, and avoid new parser dependencies. Maintain separate assertions for Markdown-link visibility and HTML-navigation visibility so future masking changes cannot silently merge those channels.
decision.acceptance: Original receiving-specific cases must establish that: (1) an eligible top-level type-7 block masks link-like Markdown until, but not including, its terminating blank line; (2) the same opener inside an active paragraph remains ordinary inline content and subsequent Markdown destinations are still found; (3) an indented lookalike does not start this raw-HTML state; (4) offsets, line numbers, CRLF/LF endings, and total text length are unchanged after masking; (5) a destination after the terminating blank line is found; (6) actual HTML navigation elements remain available to the separate navigation scan; and (7) existing type 1–6, fenced-code, inline-code, and ordinary inline-HTML behavior remains unchanged within existing resource limits.
decision.novelty: Within the complete declared implementation scope, selected and default both resolve to a692491a7a973032d90545bc6f428ba6b77f706f.
